subject.title: `infer model run` leaves a persistent session + transcript on every invocation (unbounded growth)

question: Should gateway `infer model run` probes become ephemeral or hidden from normal session lists by default, or should visible pressure-gated model-run session history remain the intended contract?
rationale: Current main intentionally preserves below-cap model-run probe sessions after the merged cleanup PR, while this issue asks to remove or hide every one-shot probe session; that is a session-lifecycle product decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Make Probes Ephemeral Or Hidden
options.body: Change gateway model runs so they do not create client-visible durable sessions by default, while retaining cleanup for rows already created by older releases.

options.title: Keep Visible Probe History
options.body: Treat pressure-gated 24h cleanup as the intended contract and document that recurring probes may remain visible until cap pressure or manual cleanup.

options.title: Add A Filter Or Opt-Out Surface
options.body: Keep persistence but add a supported `sessions.list` filter or explicit CLI opt-out after approving the new public surface.

recommendation.title: Make Probes Ephemeral Or Hidden
recommendation.body: Change gateway model runs so they do not create client-visible durable sessions by default, while retaining cleanup for rows already created by older releases.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman is the clearest recent owner for the merged pressure-gated model-run cleanup contract and related session lifecycle policy.
